content.text: Our Amazing Shillong with Mawphlang Village trip is specially designed for all those of you who are looking for a small week-long break to get away from your routine and enjoy a breath of fresh air. You will visit Cherrapunji followed by Mawlynnong and Dawki for an ultimate leisure experience in the hilly region.

blocks.label: Tour Type
blocks.value: Family Tour, Sightseeing Tour, Group Tour

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Sightseeing of magnificent Umiam lake
Visit the very famous Lady Hydari Park in Shillong
A day excursion of the wettest landscapes of Meghalaya
Witness the Nohkalikai Falls, Dainthlen Falls, Wei Sawdong Falls and the Seven Sisters Falls
Experience village life at Asia’s Cleanest Village, Mawlynnong
Trek to the Single Living Root Bridge at Riwai
Enjoy viewing the beautiful site of Krang Suri Falls
Examine the mysterious Mawphlang Village and its sacred forest

main.title: Amazing Shillong Tour with Mawphlang Village Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati Arrival- Shillong
items: Receive from Guwahati Airport by our representative and transfer to Shillong city.
Travel to the scenic view of Umaim Lake on route to Shillong.
Following a visit to the immensely famous Lady Hydari Park together with witness the greenery of Shillong Golf Course.

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Sightseeing
items: Have your delicious breakfast and travel via the breathtaking path of Cherrapunji.
Have a day excursion to the wettest landscapes of Meghalaya.
Along with witnessing Nohkalikai Falls, Dainthlen Falls, Wei Sawdong Falls and the Seven Sisters Falls in Cherrapunji.
Including getting a chance to see and explore Mawsmai Caves and the Arwah Caves.
After an exhausting day, head to your hotel and have a quiet sleep.

days.title: Day 3 : Mawlynnong and Dawki
items: Get ready after having your breakfast and head to the cleanest village, Mawlynnong.
By trekking reach the amazing Single Living Root Bridge.
Before evening witness the lucid and clean, Dawki RIver.
Stay at a nearby homestay in Mawlynnong.

days.title: Day 4 : Krangsuri and Laitlum Tour
items: After a hearty breakfast in the morning, visit the spectacular Krang Suri Fall.
Spend some amazing time admiring the beauty of the falls and click some memories there.
Afterwards, we will drive towards the grand canyons of Laitlum.
In the evening we will take you to the capital city of Meghalaya for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day 5 : Mawphlang Village and Mawsynram
items: Head to Mawphlang village after your mouth-watering breakfast.
Visit the Sacred Grove which is an ideal place for those who are nature lovers.
Later head to Mawsynram which is the one of the most wettest place on earth.
Visit the beautiful waterfalls and caves in Mawsynram.
Following return to Shillong en route and visit Elephant Falls along with the beautiful view of Shillong peak.

days.title: Day 6 : Departure Day
items: Time to say “goodbye” to Shillong as you check out of your accommodation post breakfast and leave for Guwahati Airport/Railway Station.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like change in the hotel, change in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business in the customer's bank account.
